text:
morgan: quick sync on policy editor UX. attached a tiny prototype. two decisions: slot-based snapping vs free drag; and how preview sim shows perf/cost without clutter.

jae: slot snap. makes priority mental model explicit. free drag suggests weights which we don't support.

nina: agree slot snap + keyboard moves. keyboard UX: focus card then Alt+↑/Alt+↓ to move slots, announce via live region: "Moved to slot 2".

morgan: good. what about validation? we currently show a banner. feels noisy.

jae: inline compact badge on card (small dot + short label). expand on focus to full message. copy tweak: from "Rule blocked" to "Conflict: matches Rule 1". more actionable.

ux-bot: a11y check: inline badge color fails contrast (3.7:1). recommend #7A0018 or bold text. Also ensure drag handle is 28x28 and keyboard-focusable.

nina: preview sim idea: a toggle in the top-right to enable simulation, then a slider to pick sample % and a checkbox "show perf overlay". overlay shows median latency line + p95 cost band. default off.

morgan: product wants per-rule delta on hover when sim enabled (+3ms / +$0.001). keep deltas collapsed behind a chevron to reduce noise.

jae: animation notes: animate translate + opacity for placeholder to avoid layout jumps. keyboard moves should also animate and announce new position.

nina: empty state copy: "No rules yet — rules run top → bottom. Add a rule to short-circuit requests." CTA: "Create rule" and small hint: "press r to add".

morgan: action items: 1) comps with slot snap + micro-anim (jae), 2) compact inline badge + aria-describedby (nina), 3) update error colors per lint (jae), 4) preview sim control + per-rule delta collapsed by default (morgan). timeline: comps by tomorrow EOD, eng sync after.

jae: will drop CSS snippet for drag state in the thread.

morgan: tagging @eng-frontend for visibility. thanks :sparkles:
